info.title: Zscaler Private Access
info.description:
Full Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) API surface, extracted from Zscaler's official zscaler-sdk-go source (github.com/zscaler/zscaler-sdk-go, release v3.8.48) -- endpoint paths, HTTP verbs, and field-level request/response schemas were derived directly from the SDK's typed Go structs and service functions. Preserved as-is (uncurated) for reference; see zscaler_zpa_api-latest.json for the curated subset covering common CRUD automation.

Authentication: OAuth2 client-credentials via Zscaler's unified OneAPI platform (brokered through Zidentity), or legacy per-tenant client_id/client_secret/customer_id auth (not modeled here).

Source: https://github.com/zscaler/zscaler-sdk-go/tree/v3.8.48/zscaler/zpa/services

oneApiOAuth2.description: OneAPI OAuth2 client-credentials flow via Zidentity. Token URL uses your organization's vanity domain: https://<vanityDomain>.zslogin.net/oauth2/v1/token. The token request also requires a fixed audience parameter (audience=https://api.zscaler.com) alongside client_id/client_secret -- configure this as an extra static token-request parameter on the integration if your platform version supports it.

microtenantId.description: The unique identifier of the microtenant the Service Edge Group belongs to.

microtenantName.description: The name of the microtenant the Service Edge Group belongs to.

creationTime.description: Timestamp when the Service Edge Group was created.

modifiedBy.description: ID of the admin who last modified the Service Edge Group.

modifiedTime.description: Timestamp when the Service Edge Group was last modified.

TrustedNetwork.description: A read-only trusted network definition used as an access policy condition (managed via Zscaler Client Connector, not created through this API).

id.description: Unique identifier of the trusted network.

networkId.description: The network ID referenced by access policy conditions.

domain.description: The domain associated with the trusted network.

zscalerCloud.description: The Zscaler cloud this trusted network is associated with.

creationTime.description: Timestamp when the trusted network was created.

modifiedBy.description: ID of the admin who last modified the trusted network.

modifiedTime.description: Timestamp when the trusted network was last modified.

applicationId.description: The unique identifier of the application segment.

weightedLoadBalancing.description: Whether weighted load balancing is enabled for the application segment.

applicationToServerGroupMappings.description: The per-server-group weight assignments for this application segment.

id.description: The unique identifier of the server group.

name.description: The name of the server group.

weight.description: The relative weight assigned to this server group.

passive.description: Whether this server group is passive (backup) rather than active.
